notes.title: Fisti-Fluffs Patch Notes: 2.0.4
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

We got some exciting updates cooking in the oven but for now, I wanted to get in some bug fixes for you all!
[list]
[*]Fixed an intermittent issue where the game would crash when entering the main menu settings
[*]Additional mouse support added to Title Screen for selecting adjacent menu options
[*]Controller/Keyboard state update ensuring that icons will stay more consistent while switching between keyboard and controller on menus
[*]Slightly decreased the power of the Ground Slam
[*]Performance adjustments
[/list]

Thank you for the continued support!
-Trace

notes.title: Fisti-Fluffs Patch Notes: 2.0.0-2.0.3
notes.notes:
Hi all! 
Now that these updates are available I wanted to list out some patch notes for you all to give a more detailed overview about what has been updated.

2.0.0:
GAMEPLAY OVERHAUL
[list]
[*] Added charge attack versions of input attacks and ground slam
[*] Added an explosive attack when releasing a ground slam with perfect timing
[*] Moving while shielding will now perform a dodge roll 
[*] Adjusted attacks to perform new aerial versions when performed in the air
[*] Updated the chargeable pounce to perform a grapple attack where the two cats will compete in a smoke cloud
[*] Added indicator to display underneath airborne cats
[*] Added Fire and Ice Power-up Fish 
[*] Movement overhaul, includes new animations for running and an updated physics model for cats
[*] Updated HUD graphics and outlines cats
[*] Updated graphics when progressing through Party
[*] Adjusted Party progression
[*] Set Party as default game mode 
[*] Adjusted default music mode to be Metal
[*] Balance adjustments to Crown Control. Crown bearing cat will now be knocked out in one hit
[*] Adjustments to stage graphics
[*] Additional bug fixes
[/list]

2.0.1:
[list]
[*] Widescreen and Ultra widescreen support have been added.
[*] Added a Bowtie outfit and Detective Outfit
[*] Adjusted Party Mode results to display cat outfits
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the Directional Pad from being used on the match lobby
[*] Stability improvements
[*] Adjusted formatting for localizations
[/list]

2.0.2:
[list]
[*] Adjusted Outfits menu to be more responsive when using mouse and keyboard
[*] Bug fixes for more stable menu progression
[*] Adjusted formatting for localizations
[/list]


2.0.3:
[list]
[*] Adjusted loading screen text and localizations
[*] Adjusted graphic behind button prompt when opening up settings in the player lobby
[/list]

Hope you all have fun Tussling!
-Trace

notes.title: Fisti-Fluffs 2.0 - An Explosive Update!
notes.notes:
They say you can’t teach an old dog new tricks… and that’s why dogs are dumb, and cats rule. The Fisti-Fluffs cats have learned a ton of new tricks, so many we had to go and completely overhaul the combat system. Behold the bombastic glory of Fisti-Fluffs 2.0!

[previewyoutube=bxsC5epndx0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Check out all these updates![/b]
[list]
[*] Unleash heck upon your world with brand new combos, and enhanced moves, like the new and improved ground slam attack that can send your opponents flying!
[*] Snag all-new powerups like the spicy fish that gives your feline friend flaming meows! Or grab the frozen fish to unleash ice powers that can freeze a cat in their tracks!
[*] A whole slew of new VFX add even more flair to these fabulous felines.
[*] Did we mention they got cuter too? There are even more hats and outfits to unlock, so you can customize your own cat!
[*] We’ve also done a bunch of optimization and bug fixes so Fisti-Fluffs runs smoother than ever.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38802647/e109c63da234ebb8476579034906ed6133471bd1.png[/img]

This free update for Fisti-Fluffs is available now! Be sure to use photo mode to capture your custom cats mid-combat, and share it with us on the Community page!

[b]PRESS AND CONTENT CREATORS[/b]
Want to review Fisti-Fluffs 2.0? Send a request to media@rogueco.com

notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
In addition to general bug fixes the following adjustments have been made:

- Increased Gravity Scale so that cats will fall faster 
- Significantly increased turning speed
- Added a feature to change cats while interacting in Playroom
- Adjusted menus to be navigated easier when using only a Mouse
- Adjusted spawn rates in Kibble Defense after wave 20 to spawn more enemies
- Increased snow detail on the Backyard stage
